derivation.dgx02: Six groups re-seeded on 2026-11-09 (#338): hooks:plain, hooks:spoolAndExit, hooks:jcode, hooks:sessionStart, hooks:sessionStartRepoLog and hooks:drain. Median of the per-run group p95 across 3 clean-main unconstrained (no taskset) remote_dev verify runs at main 9a1792a0a059 (tree 879d04294966) on the remote Linux runner. Per-run nearest-rank p95, run 1 / run 2 / run 3: hooks:plain [86.71875, 86.74609375, 86.68359375] -> 86.71875 MB -> 86.72; hooks:spoolAndExit [88.9765625, 89.15625, 89.046875] -> 89.046875 MB -> 89.05; hooks:jcode [86.76171875, 86.76171875, 86.97265625] -> 86.76171875 MB -> 86.76; hooks:sessionStart [49.98046875, 50.11328125, 50.05078125] -> 50.05078125 MB -> 50.05; hooks:sessionStartRepoLog [52.59765625, 52.61328125, 51.3671875] -> 52.59765625 MB -> 52.60; hooks:drain [88.6875, 89.0390625, 89.16796875] -> 89.0390625 MB -> 89.04 (rounded only the final medians to the existing two-decimal precision). Every run carries the dgx02 marker and each group's fixed sample count (plain 40, spoolAndExit 15, jcode 40, sessionStart 20, sessionStartRepoLog 20, drain 1), with no retries, no discarded samples, no pooling, trimming, CPU-name or job-outcome filter. Each p95 is that count's nearest-rank value: the 38th of 40, the 15th of 15, the 38th of 40, the 19th of 20, the 19th of 20 and, for drain, its single sample. Each run was accepted only with a start-of-run 1-minute load far below the host policy (18.00, 21.55 and 20.36 against max_load_ratio 0.7 of 224 CPUs) and one co-tenant verify container. Raw logs are not committed (scratchpad/**/*.log is gitignored): recal-main-1.log SHA256 964c549393956ff1545d6682ca23388770c07ba4252b6d72a923281ddcb31efd, recal-main-2.log SHA256 144f240649a32075dfdda2278c4ba3dc2fb2f8ef695387041b28f183e908474b, recal-main-3.log SHA256 602b7670faf0391c98f42d991032fb94c6173b57fcd7d362bc0751da65134462. These replace the 2026-11-02 seed for those six groups (median of the group p95 across 3 unconstrained remote_dev verify runs at main 9aac257), because the runner environment moved under unchanged code: the same six groups already read 5.7-18 MB above that seed at 9aac257 itself (85.70, 87.86, 88.02, 85.85, 49.43, 52.03), main 9a1792a added only 0.6-1.3 MB over 9aac257 on that runner, hooks:jcodeJournal (the only dgx02 group measured after the 2026-11-08 runner image rebuild) was the only group inside its limit (89.28 against 89.26), Bun stayed 1.4.2 in .bun-version with image and container limits unchanged. The runner image is not pinned: its base is a floating node:24-trixie tag, so the same drift can recur; pinning a digest is remote-runner follow-up in the workspace, not this repository. The other dgx02 entries (transcript:Stop, transcript:SessionEnd, transcript:StopBurst and the three full-spool groups) keep the 2026-11-02 seed and were not re-measured here. Unconstrained, because CI also runs unconstrained; taskset runs characterize contention, not the steady baseline. A dgx02 run must set AMEM_RUNNER=dgx02 to be judged against these.
